Hi, I am Rahul Nair. Online, I usually go by `unrahul`.

This is where I write through systems work in enough detail that someone else
can reproduce it. Recent posts start with a small runnable example, then follow
the Intel GPU, inference-server, kernel, or model-internals problem through to
the measurements that changed my mind. Older notes cover Rust, machine
learning, and the occasional not-so-technical detour.

The image on the left came from an early Stable Diffusion experiment with this
prompt:

> Dalí designing a cyberpunk version of a dream he had about a futuristic
> microprocessor.
